### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **291** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**65** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 52 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `da3b96012a746e1280d55316d0a0b2a822ef9d82` — the merge of head `8fa92e09664121af683c354ae30966bde70a16d1` into base `5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin da3b96012a746e1280d55316d0a0b2a822ef9d82 && git checkout da3b96012a746e1280d55316d0a0b2a822ef9d82
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67 8fa92e09664121af683c354ae30966bde70a16d1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67 && git merge --no-ff 8fa92e09664121af683c354ae30966bde70a16d1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5f0037449256ccb0855e258ffc4fd4bff84d1a67` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — CHANGES · domain:server#2 · Head-sha: `4281e7faafd9540fea3f11d2e22704de9d69ef8d` · 2026-11-07T13:40Z

契约复审第一轮,退回两处,改后复读。

- **Blocking — `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ar.ts:46`:** `group_approvals` 译成 `'بانتظار موافقتي'`(「待我审批」),这是账户应用 `nav_account_approvals` 的钉子措辞,被带进了 Setup 的分组名。Setup 的这个分组装的是收件箱、请求、历史、委托四项,en 为 `Approvals`,zh-Hant 为 `核准`、zh-CN 为 `审批`。应为 `'الموافقات'`(与 `ui/packages/i18n` `ar` 的 `approvals: "الموافقات"` 一致)。
- **Should-fix — `ar.ts:90`:** `nav_settings_hub` 为 `'كل الإعدادات'`;Console 返回设置首页的链接(`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts` `backToHub`)写的是 `"جميع الإعدادات"`。zh-Hant / zh-CN 两个已落地语言的 `nav_settings_hub` 都与各自 `backToHub` 逐字相同(`全部設定` / `全部设置`),`ar` 应同样取 `'جميع الإعدادات'`。
- **Nit(可随手改,不阻塞):** `lease`(工作者租约)译为 `عقد الإيجار`(房屋租约)、`Audiences` 译为 `الجماهير`(大众),共 4 处;建议 `مهلة الحجز` / `الجمهور المستهدف` 一类说法。

**已核且无异议:** 35 个文件与 #30951 的文件形状一一对应(`packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` 不需改:它从 `SetupAppTranslations` 取语言表,#30951 改它只为 `zh-Hant` 的书写体子标签);无阿拉伯文的值只有标识符与代码示例(objects 12、forms 11、nav 1 `Studio`,与 zh-Hant 一致);无黏连 `و` 接拉丁标识符;`nav_account_approvals` = `plugin-approvals` `ar` 的 `my_pending`「بانتظار موافقتي」;`nav_assignment_rules` = `plugin-sharing` `ar` 的 `pluralLabel`「قواعد الإسناد」;`nav_settings_localization` / `ai` / `lifecycle` 与 `service-settings` `ar` 的 hub 标题逐字相同;#30935 三键按派单。随机抽 56 条 en/ar 对照,措辞准确。

**CI:** `Test Core (3/8)` 红判为 flake(见本 PR 上席位的判读评论,`Last-Modified` 跨秒),已按规则重跑一次。

改完两处后推新 head,席位复读增量并给 ACCEPT;本 PR 超过 3000 行,ACCEPT 后请 os-zhuang / hotlong 人工合并。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · Head-sha: `8fa92e09664121af683c354ae30966bde70a16d1` · 2026-11-07T13:45Z

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台内置对象、Studio 元数据表单、设置 / Studio / 账户三个应用的导航、系统概览和用户 / 组织页内联文案,补上阿拉伯语(`ar`)。#30512 第 3 期 platform-objects 包 7 种语言中的第 2 种(继 zh-Hant #30951)。
- 为什么改:平台语言表要求每个界面带齐所有平台语言;阿拉伯语管理员打开平台不再大面积看到英文。
- 风险与回滚:只加翻译数据和注册行,不动逻辑、schema、接口;原有语言一字未改;测试只是把 `ar` 加进各语言列表。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ar.ts`(导航约 140 条),再抽看任一 `ar.*.generated.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects` 输出 in sync。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 超过 3000 行(7,187 行,多为生成物),按规程需 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 人工批准后合并。
- 席位意见:接受。第一轮退回的两处措辞已改对。

## 席位核对(增量 `4281e7faaf..8fa92e0966`)

- 3 files, +12 −12, all `ar` bundles; nothing outside them.
- **Blocking fixed:** `ar.ts` `group_approvals` = `'الموافقات'` (Setup group; en `Approvals`, zh-Hant `核准`). Dev confirms no other key shared the pinned `my_pending` wording.
- **Should-fix fixed:** `nav_settings_hub` = `'جميع الإعدادات'`, word for word `ui/packages/i18n` `ar` `backToHub`.
- **Nits taken:** worker/queue lease now `حجز` / `مهلة الحجز` (5 strings, including `decommission_lease` label, help and expiry label); share-link audiences now `فئات الجمهور المستهدف` (3 strings); one more mistranslation found by the dev and fixed: `sys_user.role` help, tenancy posture `وضع الإيجار` → `وضعية المستأجرين`. Read as a word diff.
- **Dev's re-reading:** extract re-run changes only these three files; provenance table unchanged; platform-objects 117 files / 1,683 tests pass; hub-parity, approvals and security cross-package tests pass; `check:i18n`, `i18n-stale-fill`, nul-bytes, `check-cli-command-ids` exit 0.
- **First-round record stands** for everything else (file shape vs #30951, identifier-only leftovers, pins, 56-string sample).
- **Clause-②: no** holds. `Part of #30512`, card stays open (`fr` follows after this lands).
- **Landing:** waits for every check green or expected-skip on `8fa92e0966`; then the seat flips ready and asks os-zhuang / hotlong for the human approval the size gate requires.
